notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Since last version, many improvements, new features, and fixes have been implemented to make the game richer, smoother, and more strategic. Here’s a quick overview of what I'm working on!

[h2]⚔️ Brand-New Combat System[/h2]
The combat system has been updated since the first version to provide more dynamic and tactical battles. Expect more variation in combats through abilities.

[h2]🧪 Abilities Are Here![/h2]
Introducing a brand-new Ability system:
[list]
[*] Items and characters can now hold special abilities, some with conditional triggers.
[*] A dedicated Ability capsule in the UI lets you see the abilities attached, with its description in a tooltip.
[*] Lots of unique abilities have been added: Wandering Soul, Veil of Retaliation, Heartpiercer, Amber Edge, and more to discover.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580711/9e5c4e800a8b9dcc446b3f5cdb8e55dbebda3492.png[/img]
[h2]📜 Your Own Adventure Journal[/h2]
A new Journal system will soon track key events, discoveries, and goals. You’ll never lose sight of your journey again.

[h2]🌍 New Stories and Discoveries[/h2]
The world has been expanded with new context-based stories, including:
[list]
[*] Unique events for travel and terrain types.
[*] Interactions with non playing characters.
[*] Special events triggered by your level, choices, or actions.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580711/7b1ca24c44d54b6d39366938e9818fa240836708.png[/img]
[h2]✨ Other Notable Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes.
[*] Tweaked balancing.
[*] Massive internal refactors for easier features addition.
[/list]
[h2]🔍 And Finally…[/h2]
This update also focused on quality of life improvements and preparation for the Steam Next Fest, with a trimmed down demo version made just for the event. Tons of bug fixes and under the hood optimizations have been completed.

[h2]Thanks for Your Support![/h2]
If you’ve tried the demo or followed the project, your feedback is incredibly valuable. Keep sharing your impressions on Discord or Steam, it helps me prioritize future updates.

See you in the next version!

notes.title: Playtest update #2
notes.content:
This is a major version update, local saves will be reset.

- New rules, combat is now 1dx+att vs 1dx+def
- Swapped Worg and Spectre
- XP are fixed per monsters, not computed
- Focus bug fixes
- Right buttons are disabled when not available
- Add Steam achievements (unlock at normal difficulty at least)
- Add Steam leaderboards (at normal difficulty at least)
- Fast combat setting is replaced by Veteran and Voidcall achievements
- Add Reset button is restart a quickly restart a run

notes.title: Playtest Announcement
notes.content:
Hello explorers!

We're excited to announce that a public playtest for Noon Stone just begins: jump in! This is your chance to get early access, explore the hand-drawn world, test the tactical systems, and help shape the game with your feedback.

[h2]👀 What to expect[/h2]
[list]
[*]A slice of the full experience with procedural exploration
[*]Tactical, dice-based combat
[*]Shops, gears, and increasing dangers
[*]Beat-your-own-score replayability
[*]Difficulty settings
[/list]
[h2]🔍 Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*]No end-game through taverns
[*]Exploration limited to 300 days
[*]Only one character unlocked
[/list]
[h2]🕐 When?[/h2]
Playtest access just opened!

📝 We’re counting on your impressions! Whether you find a bug, love a mechanic, or just have thoughts to share: your feedback is incredibly valuable.

Let’s find the Noon Stone together. See you on the map!

— RedderNoon —
